name: RD Technologies HKDR
oneLiner: HKDR is RD InnoTech's pre-launch HKD stablecoin, in HKMA sandbox since 2024 but not in the first April 2026 license batch; H2 2026 candidate.
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets in segregated custody at licensed financial institutions; reserves to be disclosed via periodic independent attestation per HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance
pegMechanism: Planned HKD fiat-referenced stablecoin targeting 1:1 HKD backing and regulated issuer redemption under the HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance; as of 2026-05-13, RD InnoTech remains pre-launch and was not included in the first HKMA licensed issuer batch
launchPhaseDetail: Issued by RD InnoTech Limited (a subsidiary of RD Technologies, founded by former HKMA chief executive Norman Chan); admitted to the HKMA stablecoin issuer sandbox in the first July 2024 cohort. Raised $40M in Series A2 (July 30 2025, led by ZA Global) and signed a Memorandum of Understanding with ZA Bank for HKDR reserve custody and potential distribution pending regulatory approval — the first major collaboration between a licensed HK virtual bank and a stablecoin development company. Hong Kong Stablecoins Ordinance took effect August 1 2025; 36 formal applications were received by the September deadline. HKMA granted its first two stablecoin licences on April 10 2026 to Anchorpoint Financial (FRS01) and HSBC (FRS02) — RD InnoTech was not in the first batch. HSBC plans its HKD stablecoin launch for H2 2026; a second licence wave is expected and RD InnoTech, with its early sandbox participation, $40M war chest, and ZA Bank partnership, remains among the credible next-round candidates. HK$25M minimum paid-up capital and 100%+ reserve backing requirements already met under sandbox conditions.

featuredContent.title: Announcement: RD Technologies joins the HKMA Stablecoin Issuer Sandbox

featuredContent.title: RD Technologies celebrates passage of Stablecoins Ordinance in Hong Kong
featuredContent.description: RD Technologies welcomes Hong Kong's stablecoin regulatory framework; positions HKDR for licensing under the new regime taking effect August 2025.

featuredContent.title: Hong Kong signals caution in stablecoin license rollout
featuredContent.description: HKMA chief executive Eddie Yue signals only a 'very small number' of stablecoin licences will be granted in the first wave, targeting March 2026 issuance.

featuredContent.title: Hong Kong fintech RD Technologies raises $40 million ahead of stablecoin licensing rollout
featuredContent.description: Series A2 round closes one day before the Stablecoins Ordinance takes effect; ZA Bank MOU adds reserve custody and potential distribution angle.

milestones.title: RD InnoTech enters HKMA Stablecoin Issuer Sandbox (first cohort)
milestones.description: HKDR begins sandbox testing for digital asset trading and cross-border trade payments under HKMA supervision.

milestones.title: Cobo designated preferred wallet partner for HKDR custody infrastructure
RD InnoTech names HashKey Exchange as distribution partner; Ethereum confirmed as deployment chain
Hong Kong Stablecoins Ordinance passed; takes effect August 1 2025
milestones.description: Legislative Council passes the Stablecoins Ordinance, mandating HKMA licensing for issuers of fiat-referenced stablecoins; RD Technologies welcomes the framework.

milestones.title: RD Technologies closes $40M Series A2 financing
milestones.description: Eight-investor round led by ZA Global alongside China Harbour, Bright Venture, Hivemind Capital, HSG, Eternal Digital, CMSC Partners, and Guotai Junan International PE; announced one day before the Stablecoins Ordinance licensing regime took effect.

milestones.title: ZA Bank signs MOU for HKDR reserve custody and potential distribution
milestones.description: ZA Bank (subsidiary of ZA Global, Hong Kong's first licensed virtual bank) will explore reserve asset custody services and a potential distribution role for HKDR, pending regulatory approval; first major collaboration between a licensed HK virtual bank and a stablecoin development company.

milestones.title: Hong Kong Stablecoins Ordinance licensing regime takes effect
milestones.description: HKMA formally opens licensing for issuers of fiat-referenced stablecoins; 36 formal applications received by the September 30 2025 deadline.

milestones.title: HKMA confirms first batch of stablecoin licences targeted for March 2026
milestones.description: Eddie Yue signals stability over speed and limits initial licences to 'a very small number'; RD InnoTech named among credible candidates given early sandbox participation.

milestones.title: HKMA grants first two stablecoin licences to HSBC and Anchorpoint Financial; RD InnoTech not in first batch
milestones.description: HKMA awards FRS01 to Anchorpoint Financial Limited and FRS02 to HSBC after receiving 36 applications. RD InnoTech was among the 5 original sandbox participants but was not licensed in this first wave. HSBC plans H2 2026 for its HKD stablecoin launch.

milestones.title: HKMA confirms further stablecoin licence applications under review with no set timetable
milestones.description: In a LegCo LCQ6 reply, the HKMA said the remaining licence applications stay under review with an open-but-cautious stance and no timetable for further grants — leaving RD InnoTech's licence, and any HKDR launch window, unconfirmed.
